data: Which of the following metrics are used in Figure 4 to assess the performance of monolingual experiments?

The question asks which metrics are used in Figure 4 to assess the performance of monolingual experiments. From the caption, we know that the figure shows RSIM scores, mapping performance (monolingual "BLI") on HFREQ and LFREQ EN words, and monolingual word similarity scores on SimVerb-3500. 

In the first graph (a), the metrics shown are RSIM-LFREQ, Map-LFREQ, and Map-HFREQ. In the second graph (b), the same metrics are shown. Therefore, the metrics used in Figure 4 to assess the performance of monolingual experiments are RSIM scores, mapping performance (monolingual "BLI") on HFREQ and LFREQ EN words, and monolingual word similarity scores on SimVerb-3500.
